summary: No critical correctness problems were identified. The main concerns are a conflicting duplicate grid declaration whose result depends on source order and dense formatting that obscures individual rules and increases review risk.

grade.rationale: The declarations are syntactically coherent and generally consistent, although the scan-grid column count is defined twice with different values.
A source-order-dependent override leaves obsolete configuration in place, while multiple selectors compressed onto single lines make future changes and merge conflict resolution more difficult.
Selector names are generally descriptive, but dense formatting and the unexplained three-to-four-column override obscure the stylesheet's intended final state.
Error and unavailable states have explicit visual treatments. No material CSS-specific error-state omission is evident from the supplied file alone.
Stable class selectors support UI assertions, but source-order-dependent declarations make expected layout behavior less explicit. Coverage remains unknown because no coverage evidence was supplied.

findings.title: Scan grid column count is defined twice with conflicting values
findings.description: The initial `.scan-grid` rule configures three columns, while a later rule changes the same property to four columns. The three-column declaration is therefore dead under the current source order, and moving or splitting these rules could silently change the layout.
findings.recommendation: Keep a single canonical `grid-template-columns` declaration with the intended four-column value, or place a context-specific override under a distinct selector or documented responsive condition.

findings.title: Multiple rules are compressed onto long source lines
findings.description: The stylesheet places complete adjacent rule sets on the same line and removes normal declaration spacing. This makes diffs, reviews, breakpoint debugging, and precise ownership of changes unnecessarily difficult.
findings.recommendation: Apply the project's CSS formatter so each selector block and declaration is consistently separated. Enforce that formatting in CI once the frontend linting dependencies are available.
